title: Crate
description: Nine Beatles LPs standing in a stack on a light page. Drag or scroll to flip sleeves forward and back, with a soft paper flick for each one; tap the front sleeve to pull it up and slide its record out.
intent: One record-shop gesture, flattened to the essentials: real covers in a clean CSS 3D stack you dig through with your hand, and a black record that slides out of the sleeve you choose.
